en: A black-and-white vintage photograph showing people dressed in early 20th-century attire playing tennis outdoors. The tennis courts are surrounded by tall trees and a small, almost chalet-style building with a prominent gable and flag. The image exudes a genteel, park-like atmosphere typical of spa towns or resorts of that era. The reverse side of the postcard features museum and publication information, as well as space for an address and message.
